courses.title: Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes & DevOps Engineering
courses.summary: Automate, containerize, and operate resilient cloud infrastructures using Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform IaC, GitHub Actions, and AWS cloud services.
courses.description: Modern software engineering requires continuous delivery and operational resilience. In this course, you will build and provision reproducible cloud environments from code, manage multi-node Kubernetes clusters, deploy ingress controllers, configure automated CI/CD pipelines, and monitor distributed applications with Prometheus and Grafana.
courses.eligibility: Basic familiarity with Linux shell commands and basic web networking principles (TCP/IP, DNS, ports).

modules.title: Module 1: Linux Systems & Containerization with Docker
modules.description: Linux systems administration, process isolation, namespaces, and multi-stage Docker builds.
topics: Linux systems: Bash scripting, systemd, permissions, and network troubleshooting
Docker internals: Namespaces, cgroups, layered filesystem, and image optimization
Docker Compose for multi-container development environments
Container security, rootless containers, and vulnerability scanning with Trivy

modules.title: Module 2: Kubernetes Orchestration & Cluster Management
modules.description: Deploying and managing production workloads on Kubernetes.
topics: Kubernetes architecture: Control plane, kubelet, etcd, and worker nodes
Pods, Deployments, ReplicaSets, StatefulSets, and DaemonSets
Services, Ingress controllers, TLS cert-manager, and internal DNS
ConfigMaps, Secrets, persistent volumes, and Helm package management

modules.title: Module 3: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform & AWS
modules.description: Provisioning reproducible enterprise cloud infrastructure on AWS.
topics: AWS Core Services: VPC, Subnets, Internet Gateways, EC2, S3, and IAM roles
Terraform fundamentals: Providers, resources, state locking, and modularization
Managing remote state with S3 and DynamoDB backend
Zero-downtime rolling updates and disaster recovery planning

modules.title: Module 4: CI/CD Pipelines & Cloud Observability
modules.description: Automated continuous delivery and distributed systems monitoring.
topics: GitHub Actions: Matrix builds, secret management, and artifact caching
GitOps workflows with ArgoCD on Kubernetes
Metrics and logging with Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki
Incident response, synthetic monitoring, and SLA/SLO tracking

courses.title: Data Analytics & Modern Analytics Engineering
courses.summary: Transform messy organizational data into decision-making assets using Advanced SQL, Python data analysis, dbt transformations, and interactive executive dashboards.
courses.description: Step beyond standard spreadsheet reporting into professional data analytics. This program covers dimensional data modeling (Kimball methodology), advanced SQL analytical window functions, data wrangling with Python Pandas and DuckDB, automated dbt transformation DAGs, and crafting persuasive, human-centered business intelligence dashboards.
courses.eligibility: Comfortable with spreadsheets and numerical analysis. No prior programming background strictly required.

modules.title: Module 1: Advanced Relational SQL for Analytical Queries
modules.description: Complex querying, CTEs, window functions, and query optimization.
topics: Complex Joins, Subqueries, and Common Table Expressions (CTEs)
Window functions: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LEAD, LAG, and rolling aggregations
Performance indexing, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, and execution plans
Data normalization and Star/Snowflake dimensional schemas

modules.title: Module 2: Python for Data Analysis & Statistical Modeling
modules.description: Data manipulation with Pandas, NumPy, and statistical hypothesis testing.
topics: NumPy array operations and vectorized calculations
Pandas: DataFrames, missing value imputation, multi-indexing, and reshaping
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and distribution testing
Data visualization with Seaborn, Matplotlib, and Plotly

modules.title: Module 3: Analytics Engineering with dbt & Cloud Data Warehouses
modules.description: Building production data pipelines with dbt (data build tool).
topics: Modern Data Stack overview: Snowflake, BigQuery, and DuckDB
dbt fundamentals: Models, sources, seeds, and Jinja templating
Testing data quality, freshness tests, and documentation generation
Incremental data models and orchestration with scheduling tools

modules.title: Module 4: Business Intelligence & Executive Storytelling
modules.description: Translating data insights into executive action.
topics: Dashboard UX design principles: Visual hierarchy and cognitive load reduction
Building interactive dashboards in Power BI and Tableau
Cohort analysis, retention curves, and churn analysis
Executive presentation strategies and data storytelling

courses.title: Cybersecurity Defense, SOC Operations & Ethical Hacking
courses.summary: Defend enterprise IT perimeters, conduct vulnerability assessments, monitor SIEM security alerts, and execute controlled ethical penetration testing.
courses.description: A practical, laboratory-driven curriculum focusing on defensive engineering and blue team operations. Students analyze live network traffic, configure firewall policies, investigate attack simulations in a sandboxed security operations center (SOC), and master vulnerability scanning tools.
courses.eligibility: Fundamental knowledge of operating systems (Windows and Linux) and networking protocols (TCP, UDP, DNS, TLS).

modules.title: Module 1: Network Protocols, Packet Analysis & Threat Landscapes
modules.description: Deep dive into network packets, OSI layers, and attack vectors.
topics: Packet capture and dissection with Wireshark and tcpdump
TCP/IP handshakes, ARP poisoning, and DNS spoofing analysis
Common vulnerability enumeration: MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP Top 10
Hardening network devices, VLANs, and firewall rule configurations

modules.title: Module 2: Vulnerability Assessment & Defensive Architecture
modules.description: Scanning, hardening, and establishing zero-trust access controls.
topics: Vulnerability scanning with Nessus and OpenVAS
Operating system hardening benchmarks (CIS benchmarks)
Identity and Access Management (IAM), MFA, and Zero Trust models
Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents and telemetry

modules.title: Module 3: Security Operations Center (SOC) & SIEM Analysis
modules.description: Investigating alerts, log correlation, and incident response playbooks.
topics: Log ingestion and search using Splunk and ELK stack
Writing detection rules for brute force, lateral movement, and data exfiltration
Incident response lifecycle (NIST / SANS frameworks)
Memory analysis, digital forensics, and chain of custody preservation

modules.title: Module 4: Ethical Penetration Testing & Web Application Security
modules.description: Hands-on controlled penetration testing methodologies.
topics: Reconnaissance, port scanning, and service enumeration with Nmap
Exploiting web vulnerabilities: SQLi, XSS, CSRF, and SSRF in controlled labs
Privilege escalation techniques on Linux and Windows
Remediation reporting and communicating technical risk to stakeholders

courses.title: Python for Systems Automation, APIs & Scripting
courses.summary: Master modern Python 3, object-oriented software design, asynchronous concurrency, robust API development with FastAPI, and automated system scripts.
courses.description: Engineered for developers, IT administrators, and career-changers who want a rock-solid Python programming foundation. You will write idiomatic, performant Python code, interact with external REST APIs, automate file and database workflows, and package your own CLI tools.
courses.eligibility: Beginners with strong curiosity and problem-solving drive. No prior programming needed.

modules.title: Module 1: Core Python Syntax, Data Structures & Logic
modules.description: Building strong fundamentals with data structures and procedural logic.
topics: Python data types, immutability, lists, dictionaries, sets, and tuples
Flow control, list comprehensions, and generator expressions
Functions, scope, closures, and first-class functions
File I/O operations, JSON/CSV parsing, and exception handling

modules.title: Module 2: Object-Oriented Design & Clean Code Practices
modules.description: Writing maintainable, modular, and testable code.
topics: Classes, instances, inheritance, and encapsulation
Dunder methods (magic methods) and operator overloading
Type hinting with mypy and static analysis with ruff
Unit testing with pytest, fixtures, and mocking

modules.title: Module 3: Asynchronous Programming & REST API Development
modules.description: Building fast web services with FastAPI and async/await.
topics: Asyncio fundamentals: Event loop, coroutines, and tasks
FastAPI framework: Route handlers, request validation with Pydantic
Database integration with SQLAlchemy 2.0 and SQLite/PostgreSQL
Authentication, token verification, and Swagger OpenAPI documentation

modules.title: Module 4: Practical Systems Automation & CLI Utilities
modules.description: Automating operational workflows and external services.
topics: Automated web scraping with BeautifulSoup and Playwright
Automating email dispatches, scheduled cron tasks, and report generators
Building command-line utilities with Click and Typer
Virtual environments, poetry dependency management, and packaging

courses.title: Advanced Distributed Systems Architecture (Internal Preview)
courses.summary: High-throughput event-driven microservices, consensus protocols, and fault-tolerant system design. Unpublished internal curriculum preview.
courses.description: An advanced course for senior engineers currently in curriculum review. Not yet open for public student enrolments.
courses.eligibility: Senior developers with minimum 3 years of production backend experience.

modules.title: Module 1: Distributed Consensus & Raft
modules.description: Understanding consensus, quorum, and partition tolerance.
topics: CAP theorem in practice
Raft consensus mechanics
Vector clocks

courses.title: Full Stack Web Engineering with Next.js & Node.js
courses.summary: Architect and build robust, high-performance web applications using TypeScript, Next.js App Router, Express REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Redis caching.
courses.description: Designed for developers seeking full architectural mastery from database design to edge-rendered user interfaces. This course eschews superficial tutorials in favor of production realities: connection pooling, zero-downtime database migrations, atomic transactions, session and JWT authorization patterns, automated end-to-end testing, and performance profiling under load.
courses.eligibility: Basic familiarity with HTML, CSS, and general programming fundamentals. Beginners with analytical problem-solving aptitude are encouraged.

modules.title: Module 1: Advanced TypeScript & Modern JavaScript Internals
modules.description: Mastering the type system, runtime vs compile-time guarantees, asynchronous event loops, and clean code paradigms.
topics: Advanced TypeScript: Generics, utility types, conditional types, and schema validation with Zod
V8 engine internals, event loop mechanics, microtasks, and memory management
Modern ESNext patterns: Async generators, iterators, and modules
Clean Architecture principles and Domain-Driven Design concepts

modules.title: Module 2: Server Architecture with Express & Prisma ORM
modules.description: Designing scalable RESTful APIs, relational data modeling, migrations, and robust error hierarchies.
topics: RESTful API design conventions, middleware pipelines, and structured logging
PostgreSQL relational modeling, indexing strategies, foreign keys, and transactions
Prisma ORM schema design, migrations, and query performance tuning
Authentication: Secure password hashing, JWTs, HTTP-only refresh cookies, and RBAC

modules.title: Module 3: Next.js App Router & Server-Side Rendering
modules.description: Harnessing React Server Components, streaming SSR, parallel routes, and modern Tailwind CSS UI architecture.
topics: React 18/19 mental models: Server Components vs Client Components
Next.js App Router: Dynamic routing, route handlers, layouts, and error boundaries
Server Actions, optimistic updates, and form state management
Design systems with Tailwind CSS, accessible shadcn/ui primitives, and responsiveness

modules.title: Module 4: Performance, Caching, Testing & Production Deployment
modules.description: Redis caching layers, rate limiting, unit and integration testing, and CI/CD deployment pipelines.
topics: In-memory caching with Redis: Cache invalidation strategies and pub/sub
Security hardening: Helmet, CORS, CSRF defenses, and rate limiting
Automated testing: Unit tests with Vitest, integration tests with Playwright
Docker containerization, environment management, and cloud deployments

courses.title: Applied Artificial Intelligence & Large Language Models
courses.summary: Learn core machine learning paradigms, fine-tuning modern transformer models, implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and deploying scalable AI inference APIs.
courses.description: This intensive program guides engineers from foundational machine learning mathematics to deploying production-ready AI systems. You will implement embedding pipelines with pgvector, fine-tune open-weights models like Llama 3, build robust multi-agent orchestration frameworks, and measure model hallucinations with evaluation benchmarks. Every cohort builds an end-to-end proprietary knowledge base search and agentic reasoning workflow.
courses.eligibility: Prior programming proficiency in Python or another modern language. Comfort with high school mathematics (vectors, derivatives, probability) recommended.

modules.title: Module 1: Foundations of Machine Learning & Vector Math
modules.description: Supervised learning algorithms, loss functions, gradient descent, feature normalization, and vector representations.
topics: Mathematical foundations: Linear algebra, calculus & probability
Supervised vs Unsupervised learning paradigms
Regression, Classification, and Model Evaluation Metrics
Vector embeddings, distance metrics, and similarity search

modules.title: Module 2: Deep Learning & Modern Transformer Architectures
modules.description: Neural networks, backpropagation, attention mechanisms, self-attention, and the transformer encoder-decoder blueprint.
topics: Multi-layer perceptrons and gradient backpropagation in PyTorch
Attention Is All You Need: Deconstructing self-attention & multi-head attention
Tokenization, positional encodings, and context windows
Pre-trained language models: BERT, GPT, and modern decoder-only architectures

modules.title: Module 3: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Vector Databases
modules.description: Designing enterprise-grade knowledge retrieval architectures with chunking strategies and semantic reranking.
topics: Document parsing, chunking strategies, and metadata indexing
PostgreSQL pgvector, Pinecone, and hybrid BM25 + dense search
Context injection, query transformation, and cross-encoder re-ranking
Mitigating hallucinations and building automated RAG evaluation (Ragas)

modules.title: Module 4: Production LLM Deployment, Fine-Tuning & Multi-Agent Systems
modules.description: LoRA parameter-efficient fine-tuning, streaming inference servers, structured outputs, and autonomous agent orchestration.
topics: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT/LoRA) using Hugging Face
High-throughput inference with vLLM, Ollama, and FastAPI streaming
Tool-use, function calling, and LangGraph multi-agent systems
Production observability, prompt telemetry, and safety guardrails

modules.title: Module 1: Foundations & Architecture
modules.description: Core principles, system design blueprints, and setup.
topics: Core syntax
Protocols
Architectural patterns

faqs.question: How are VLEARNN programs different from online video courses?
faqs.answer: Unlike self-paced recorded tutorials with single-digit completion rates, VLEARNN operates on a rigorous cohort-based model. You learn directly from practicing industry engineers, submit weekly code projects that receive thorough line-by-line pull request reviews, and collaborate in pair-programming labs.

faqs.question: What are the prerequisite requirements for enrolling in courses?
faqs.answer: Prerequisites depend on the specific program. Foundational courses like Python and Data Analytics require zero prior coding experience. Advanced programs like Applied AI and Cloud DevOps assume familiarity with basic programming fundamentals. We offer free preparatory bridge modules before cohort kickoffs.

faqs.question: Can I take classes while working full-time?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our cohorts are specifically scheduled for working professionals and university students. Classroom and live interactive sessions are held on weekend mornings and weekday evenings. All live sessions are recorded and indexed for revision.

faqs.question: What does the 1-on-1 career mentoring support include?
faqs.answer: Mentorship includes technical portfolio auditing, resume restructuring tailored to ATS screening, system design mock interviews, behavioral prep, and direct interview referrals to our hiring network.

faqs.question: Are certificates recognized by technology employers?
faqs.answer: Upon graduating and passing all capstone project defenses, students receive a verified VLEARNN Certificate of Technical Competence with a cryptographic verification hash. More importantly, hiring managers value the verifiable GitHub repositories and deployed live projects built during the program.

faqs.question: What is the fee payment structure and refund policy?
faqs.answer: Fees can be paid upfront with an early-bird discount or structured across flexible zero-cost monthly installments. We offer a 100% money-back guarantee within the first 7 days if you find the curriculum or teaching standard does not meet expectations.

testimonials.courseName: Applied Artificial Intelligence & Large Language Models
testimonials.quote: The RAG module and vector database labs gave me the exact architecture models I needed. Instead of toy examples, we built production-grade evaluation pipelines. That capstone project directly secured my transition into AI engineering.

testimonials.courseName: Full Stack Web Engineering with Next.js & Node.js
testimonials.quote: I was tired of surface-level tutorials that never explained database connection pools, transactions, or production cache strategies. VLEARNN’s code reviews pushed my TypeScript and backend standards to a senior level.

Writing production Terraform modules and managing multi-node Kubernetes deployments with live ingress gave me true operational confidence. The mentors are practicing engineers who share real war stories.
